text:
Type: velvet textured throw pillow
Use: decorating and resting on a sofa, bed or armchair; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, glam
Materials: velvet with fine horizontal ribbed texture
Colors: azure blue, deep cool blue
Shape: square, solid color with subtle horizontal streaks, knife edges, compact and fairly flat
Feel: rich, calm, cozy
Goes with: grey, white or cream upholstery, brass or wood accents; modern or coastal living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Velvet Texture Decorative Throw Pillow, 17" x 17", Azure
product.description: A classic look with modern updates, this luxurious velvet pillow has subtle grooves running throughout. The bright color freshens up your décor, while the understated pattern allows for easy mixing and matching with other pillows. Soft velvet texture and subtle pattern for modern and classic touches Sewn in U.S. of durable polyester fabric Pillow Cover: 100% Polyester. Insert Shell: 100% Cotton. Stuffing: 100% Polyester Made in USA and Imported Removable plush fiber-filled insert included Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 17" x 17" Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
